I thought it would be fun to have a text based game on Voat but I need some help with the concept. Here's what I have so far. Anyone can form a tribe by just making a thread with the name of their tribe in brackets. People can make their own subverses if they want but really this site nor my subverse is big enough for it to matter. So once they have their tribe there'll be a weekly or daily (depending on the size this sub gets) type thing where people can guess 2 numbers between -10 and 10(Again, may be bigger. All of this is just to give you the idea.) This uses up one of their scout points. The more people in their tribe, the more scout points they have. There'll be resources on multiple points on different coordinates like a lake with fish, a forest, oil, etc. There'll be different biomes you can choose to start out at from the start. You can live in a mountainous region which offers better defense and resources but less food. As they're different biomes, they'll have their own coordinate systems with different amounts of resources. As civilizations progress out of the stone age, they get a slightly bigger coordinate system and different resources that they couldn't acquire with their previous tools. This keeps going on like this until there's massive coordinate systems with widely different resources. But you can't just get resources and start getting more resources. You have to correctly figure out the order to put certain resources in to make the tools. I'm not completely sure how this would work yet. After they learn how to make whatever it is, they can choose to teach the entire tribe or keep the knowledge to themselves to use it for later. The knowledge will only effect the tribe if you're the owner who unlocks the combination though. Each week(or day or whatever) the tribe can exchange their resources for new tools, structures, etc. I'm still in the process of thinking through how the war aspect would work but it'll be based on defenses, region, tribe size, and technology. People would be able to ally and trade with other tribes. The form of government each tribe wants to use is up to them.
